why: The match review found the same fault in six places: the picture was ADJACENT to the line rather than carrying it. The worst was the opening — 'a petrol pump is a 24-hour business' over a still, empty, nearly deserted forecourt, which says the opposite of the words. Every shot here exists to make a specific sentence true on screen.
rules: Named motion, never 'nothing moves'. Nobody walks across frame — legs slide. Nothing thin is held. Activity comes from vehicles, light and hands, not from people walking.

shots.fixes: the opening: 24-hour business shown as an empty forecourt
shots.prompt: Vertical medium-wide shot of a BUSY Indian fuel station at night, brightly lit under a plain white canopy with no coloured band or stripe. A large plain unmarked tanker truck stands at the side with its decanting hose already connected and running down to a ground hatch. Two cars are at the dispensers being filled. One attendant stands still at a nozzle with both hands on it, and a second stands beside the tanker watching the hose. NOBODY WALKS ACROSS THE FRAME. The movement is the hose flexing, a wisp of vapour at the coupling, headlights, and the slow drift of exhaust. Warm sodium light on wet concrete, moths near the lamps are absent, the sky is empty. Camera completely static. Photoreal documentary video, 35mm, natural light, warm and slightly dusty. NO text, letters, numbers, signage, lettering, logos, watermarks or captions anywhere. No oil company branding, livery, uniform or badge. No vehicle number plates.

shots.fixes: 'a person talks to you' shown as a man alone with a phone screen
shots.prompt: Vertical medium close shot of an Indian man in his mid-fifties, greying hair and trimmed moustache, cream full-sleeve shirt, sitting at a desk in a small fuel station office at night with a single warm lamp on. He holds a smartphone to his ear and listens, nodding twice; his shoulders drop, he breathes out with relief and says a short word. His feet are out of frame and he holds nothing else. Through the window behind him the forecourt is lit and soft. Camera completely static. Photoreal documentary video, 35mm. NO text, signage, lettering, logos or captions anywhere. No branding of any kind.

shots.fixes: 'people who know the pump, and IIT engineers' showing only the engineer
shots.prompt: Vertical medium shot of two Indian men side by side at a desk in a warm office. On the left a weathered man in his fifties in a plain shirt with grey stubble, the look of someone who has spent his life around machinery. On the right a young engineer in his mid-twenties in a plain dark t-shirt. Both look at a monitor just off frame. The older man speaks a few words and the younger nods and types. NEITHER POINTS OR RAISES A HAND; their hands stay low and still and hold nothing. Warm window light from the left, deep soft bokeh behind them. No sudden changes of expression. Camera completely static and rock steady. Photoreal documentary video, 35mm. NO readable screen content, no text, no logos anywhere.

shots.fixes: the brand and 'shield' beats showing a lone man at an empty pump
shots.prompt: Vertical medium shot of an Indian man in his mid-fifties, greying hair, trimmed moustache, cream full-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled, standing steady in the middle of his own BUSY fuel station forecourt in bright late-morning light, hands relaxed at his sides, looking out past the camera with quiet confidence. Behind him two cars are being filled at plain white dispensers with no coloured stripe, and an attendant stands at a nozzle with both hands on it. His feet are out of frame. He breathes in, blinks slowly, and his jaw sets. NOBODY WALKS ACROSS THE FRAME. Camera completely static. Photoreal documentary video, 35mm, warm natural light. NO text, signage, lettering, logos or number plates. No oil company branding or livery.

shots.fixes: 'news of every date, before the date' shown as a man standing still
shots.prompt: Vertical close shot of an Indian man in his mid-fifties in a cream full-sleeve shirt, sitting at a desk in a small fuel station office at night, lit by one warm lamp. His smartphone is lying face up on the desk and it lights up. He picks it up, reads, and his expression shifts from tired to relieved; he nods once and sets it back down. The phone screen is bright and completely defocused with no readable content. His feet are out of frame, the wall behind him is bare painted plaster with nothing on it. Camera completely static. Photoreal documentary video, 35mm. NO text, signage, notices, lettering or logos anywhere.
